alkylation reagent: adding the same volume of 55 mM iodoacetamide in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate
alkylation concentration: adding the same volume of 55 mM iodoacetamide in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate
cleavage agent: rehydrated with Trypsin Gold protein digest enzyme (Promega, V5280)
enrichment method: The optimized ExtraPEG precipitation method (8% PEG + wash) was used to harvest extracellular vesicles
fractionation method: 6.5 μg of protein was purified by tris-glycine sodium dodecyl sulfate polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (SDS-PAGE)
instrument: Liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis was done using an externally calibrated Thermo LTQ Orbitrap Velos nLC-ESI-LIT-Orbitrap
labeling: Liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis was done using an externally calibrated Thermo LTQ Orbitrap Velos nLC-ESI-LIT-Orbitrap
reduction reagent: reducing solution containing 25 mM dithiothreitol in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate
reduction concentration: reducing solution containing 25 mM dithiothreitol in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate
